phases.name: Foundation
phases.description: Supabase project setup, database schema, client singleton, data service abstraction, and env configuration

tasks.title: Supabase project creation and CLI setup
tasks.description: Create Supabase project (free tier), install supabase CLI, initialize supabase/config.toml, add @supabase/supabase-js dependency to package.json

tasks.title: Database schema migration (001_schema.sql)
tasks.description: Write SQL migration for all 10 tables: profiles, events, refill_schedules, test_schedules, medication_cards, notifications, payments, wallets, chat_messages, education_content, education_progress. Include primary keys, foreign keys, indexes (GIN on conditions arrays, btree on user_id + created_at), and constraints.

tasks.title: Row Level Security policies (002_rls_policies.sql)
tasks.description: Write RLS policies for all tables: user_id = auth.uid() for user-owned tables, id = auth.uid() for profiles, public SELECT for education_content. Enable RLS on all tables.

tasks.title: Education content seed migration (003_education_seed.sql)
tasks.description: Write build-time script scripts/generate-education-seed.ts that reads src/mocks/fixtures/education-cards.json (119 articles) and generates SQL INSERT statements for education_content table. Map all fields: slug, title, category, conditions, content_type, summary, body, sections, estimated_minutes, learning_objectives, image_theme.

tasks.title: Supabase client singleton and types
tasks.description: Create src/lib/supabase.ts with typed createClient<Database>, export useSupabase boolean from VITE_USE_SUPABASE env var. Generate src/types/supabase.ts via supabase gen types typescript after running migrations.

tasks.title: Data service abstraction layer
tasks.description: Create src/lib/data-service.ts with query, insert, update, invokeFunction methods. Each method branches on useSupabase — MSW path uses axios + TABLE_TO_ENDPOINT mapping, Supabase path uses supabase client directly. Supports select, filter, order, limit, single options.

tasks.title: Environment variable configuration
tasks.description: Add VITE_SUPABASE_URL, VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, VITE_USE_SUPABASE to .env.example. Update .env (gitignored) with actual Supabase project values.

phases.name: Authentication
phases.description: Supabase phone OTP auth with mock auto-fill, auth store update, and route guard

tasks.title: get-otp Edge Function
tasks.description: Create supabase/functions/get-otp/index.ts. Accepts { phone } in request body, uses service role client to read OTP from auth schema (auth.one_time_tokens or custom demo_otps table). Returns { otp } for client auto-fill. Create shared supabase/functions/_shared/supabase-admin.ts with createAdminClient() and createUserClient() helpers. Include fallback strategy: if auth.one_time_tokens is inaccessible, use custom SMS hook + demo_otps table.

tasks.title: PhoneEntryPage component
tasks.description: Create src/Routes/Patient/Pages/Auth/PhoneEntryPage.tsx. Phone number input with +254 prefix (Kenya format), validation for 9-digit number after prefix. On submit: calls supabase.auth.signInWithOtp({ phone }), navigates to /patients/auth/otp with phone in route state. Use existing form components and design tokens. Loading state during OTP send.

tasks.title: OtpVerifyPage component with auto-fill
tasks.description: Create src/Routes/Patient/Pages/Auth/OtpVerifyPage.tsx. 6-digit OTP input field. On mount: calls supabase.functions.invoke('get-otp', { body: { phone } }) and auto-populates all digits. User taps 'Verify' -> calls supabase.auth.verifyOtp({ phone, token, type: 'sms' }). On success: check profiles table — no profile -> navigate to intake, has profile -> navigate to companion home.

tasks.title: Update patientAuthStore for Supabase sessions
tasks.description: Modify patientAuthStore.ts — add supabaseSession state, initializeAuth() that calls supabase.auth.getSession(), onAuthStateChange listener for session refresh/expiry. isAuthenticated computed from either MSW flags or Supabase session based on VITE_USE_SUPABASE flag.

tasks.title: Update PatientWrapper auth guard and routes
tasks.description: Modify PatientWrapper.tsx — when useSupabase, check supabase.auth.getSession() instead of localStorage flags. Route /patients/auth to PhoneEntryPage, /patients/auth/otp to OtpVerifyPage. Register new routes in PatientsHome.tsx. Auth guard wraps all authenticated routes.

phases.name: Data Layer Migration
phases.description: Migrate all 12 hooks to dual data source pattern using dataService abstraction

tasks.title: Migrate useIntakeProfile hook
tasks.description: Modify useIntakeProfile.ts to use dataService.query('profiles', { single: true }). Profile uses id = auth.uid() (not user_id). Also migrate the save/update mutation to use dataService.update or dataService.insert.

tasks.title: Migrate useRefillSchedule and useTestSchedule hooks
tasks.description: Modify both hooks to use dataService.query with appropriate table names, filters (user_id), and ordering (next_date ascending). Include mutation hooks for creating/updating/deleting schedule items.

tasks.title: Migrate useNotifications hook
tasks.description: Modify to use dataService.query('notifications', { order: { column: 'sent_at' }, filter: { user_id } }). Include markAsRead mutation using dataService.update to set read_at timestamp.

tasks.title: Migrate useMedicationCards hook
tasks.description: Modify to use dataService.query('medication_cards'). Supabase path joins with taxonomy data if needed for enrichment.

tasks.title: Migrate useRecentPayments hook
tasks.description: Modify to use dataService.query('payments', { order: { column: 'created_at' }, limit: 10 }). Map payment records to existing PaymentEvent shape for backward compatibility with UI components.

tasks.title: Migrate useCostSummary and useCostBreakdown hooks
tasks.description: These are computed queries. In Supabase mode: fetch all payments for current year, compute YTD spend, cashback earned, monthly averages client-side. useCostBreakdown groups by line item category from populated invoices. Must handle payments where line_items is still empty (pending AI population).

tasks.title: Migrate useEducationFeed and useLessonProgress hooks
tasks.description: useEducationFeed: query education_content table, filter by user's conditions (array overlap). useLessonProgress: read/write education_progress table. markSectionComplete upserts progress row, markCourseComplete sets completed=true + completed_at. On course completion, trigger generate-ai-insights Edge Function with trigger='course_complete'.

tasks.title: Migrate wallet balance query
tasks.description: Add or modify wallet hook to query wallets table in Supabase mode. Single row per user. Used by FastTrack payment flow and cost tracker.

tasks.title: Verify all UI renders correctly with Supabase data
tasks.description: End-to-end verification: with VITE_USE_SUPABASE=true, navigate through all companion screens — home, cost tracker, medications, education, notifications, profile. Confirm data loads, mutations work, and no UI regressions. Fix any data shape mismatches between Supabase query results and existing component expectations.

phases.name: Edge Functions (AI Pipeline)
phases.description: Server-side AI pipeline via Supabase Edge Functions with Gemini integration

tasks.title: generate-invoice-line-items Edge Function
tasks.description: Create supabase/functions/generate-invoice-line-items/index.ts. Accepts { paymentId }, authenticates user from JWT, fetches profile + payment + refill schedules. Builds Gemini prompt from ai-pipeline-rules.ts constants (port to Deno-compatible format). Calls Gemini gemini-3.6-flash with responseMimeType='application/json'. Validates line items sum within 10% of payment amount. Updates payments.line_items, calculates 5% cashback, upserts wallets.cashback_balance, inserts CASHBACK_EARNED event and notification. Chains call to generate-ai-insights.

tasks.title: generate-ai-insights Edge Function
tasks.description: Create supabase/functions/generate-ai-insights/index.ts. Four trigger modes: (1) post-invoice from generate-invoice-line-items, (2) on-demand from client, (3) pg_cron hourly batch, (4) event-driven (course_complete, test_upload, prescription, refill_overdue, test_overdue, cashback_milestone). Single-user mode: fetch profile + last 50 events + schedules + education progress, call Gemini, validate actions, deduplicate against last 24h notifications, insert new notifications. Batch mode: query all completed profiles, skip if notified in last hour, rate limit 10 calls/min.

tasks.title: chat-assistant Edge Function
tasks.description: Create supabase/functions/chat-assistant/index.ts. Accepts { message, conversationHistory }. Fetches full profile (conditions, medications, test schedules, cost estimates, goals), last 30 events, last 20 chat_messages. Builds system prompt (port callAssistantChat logic). Calls Gemini, saves both messages to chat_messages table. Returns { reply, suggestedQuestions }.

tasks.title: pg_cron hourly insight job (004_pg_cron.sql)
tasks.description: Write migration enabling pg_cron extension and scheduling hourly HTTP POST to generate-ai-insights Edge Function with { batch: true } body. Uses service role key from app.settings.

tasks.title: Wire payment flow to generate-invoice-line-items
tasks.description: Modify FastTrack payment flow: after successful payment insert, call supabase.functions.invoke('generate-invoice-line-items', { body: { paymentId } }). Update PaymentStatus.tsx to show 'processing invoice...' state while Edge Function runs. Add query invalidation for payments and notifications after function returns.

tasks.title: Migrate useAssistantChat to Edge Function
tasks.description: Modify useAssistantChat hook: in Supabase mode, call dataService.invokeFunction('chat-assistant', { message, conversationHistory }). Remove client-side Gemini call path. Invalidate chat_messages query key after response.

tasks.title: Wire event-driven insight triggers in client
tasks.description: Modify useAiPipeline: in Supabase mode, call generate-ai-insights Edge Function instead of client-side callLlmApi. Add trigger calls after: course completion (in useLessonProgress), test result upload (in test results page), payment completion (already handled by P4-T5). Pass trigger and triggerData in request body.

phases.name: Test Results Utility + Education Triggers
phases.description: Mock test result generator page and education-to-insight wiring

tasks.title: generate-mock-test-results Edge Function
tasks.description: Create supabase/functions/generate-mock-test-results/index.ts. Accepts { testName }, fetches profile + previous TEST_RESULT events. Builds Gemini prompt for clinically plausible metrics consistent with patient conditions and treatment. Returns JSON only: { metrics, labName, date }. No PDF generation — that happens client-side.

tasks.title: TestResultsUtility page component with client-side PDF
tasks.description: Create src/Routes/Patient/Pages/Profile/TestResultsUtility.tsx. Route: /#/patients/profile/test-results-utility. Fetches profile recurring tests + scans recent PAYMENT events for LAB_TEST line items. Displays test cards with generate button. On generate: calls generate-mock-test-results Edge Function (returns JSON metrics only), shows result preview (metrics table with color-coded status badges). 'Download PDF' button generates PDF client-side using jsPDF + jspdf-autotable (lazy-imported via dynamic import to avoid main bundle impact). PDF contains lab report header, patient name, date, and results table with color-coded status column. 'Upload these results' link navigates to test results upload page. New dependencies: jspdf, jspdf-autotable (~180KB gzipped combined).

tasks.title: Profile menu integration for Test Results Utility
tasks.description: Modify PatientProfile.tsx: add 'Test Results Utility' menu item conditionally when useSupabase is true. Icon: FlaskConical. Route: /patients/profile/test-results-utility. Register route in PatientsHome.tsx.

tasks.title: Wire test result upload to insight trigger
tasks.description: After a user uploads test results (existing test results page), call generate-ai-insights Edge Function with trigger='test_upload' and triggerData containing testName and metrics. This generates insights about the test results (trend analysis, next steps).

phases.name: Demo Seed + Polish
phases.description: Demo account data, end-to-end testing, error handling, MSW fallback verification

tasks.title: Demo seed data script
tasks.description: Create supabase/seed.sql with pre-populated demo account: auth user +254700000001, completed profile (diabetes + hypertension, Metformin + Lisinopril), 12 payments with AI-populated line items over 6 months, refill/test schedules in realistic states, 20+ notifications (mixed types), KES 2,125 cashback balance, 5 chat messages, education progress (3 completed, 2 in progress).

tasks.title: End-to-end demo flow testing
tasks.description: Test the complete flow: phone login -> OTP auto-fill -> dashboard loads with seeded data -> make a payment -> invoice line items populate -> cashback appears -> AI insights generated -> chat assistant works with profile context -> test results utility generates and downloads PDF -> upload triggers insights. Verify on both desktop and mobile viewport.

tasks.title: Error states and loading states for Edge Functions
tasks.description: Add loading spinners, error toasts, and retry buttons for all Edge Function calls: invoice generation, AI insights, chat assistant, mock test results. Handle network errors, Gemini rate limits, and timeout scenarios gracefully.

tasks.title: Verify MSW fallback (VITE_USE_SUPABASE=false)
tasks.description: With VITE_USE_SUPABASE unset or false, verify the entire app works exactly as before: MSW intercepts all requests, localStorage persists data, client-side AI pipeline runs, no Supabase-related errors or imports that break without config.
